findings.finding: SearchSecurities uses parameterized queries ($1..$5) with no string concatenation of user input. The LIKE patterns use escaped patterns via escapeLike() paired with ESCAPE E'\' in SQL.
findings.recommendation: No action needed - SQL injection risk is mitigated.

findings.finding: escapeLike() properly escapes \, %, _ characters using strings.NewReplacer so they are matched literally in ILIKE.
findings.recommendation: No action needed - LIKE escaping is correct.

findings.finding: ORDER BY CASE in SearchSecurities uses fixed columns (ticker) and parameterized likes ($3, $4 from upper(pattern)), no user-controlled text in ORDER BY clause.
findings.recommendation: No action needed - ranking injection risk is mitigated.

findings.finding: Watchlist table has FK ON DELETE CASCADE to securities(id) and UNIQUE(security_id) constraint. No user_id column (single-user design per SPEC §2.3).
findings.recommendation: No action needed - FK constraints are properly defined.

findings.finding: serveSPAIndexNegotiated correctly negotiates content: serves index.html only when Accept contains text/html AND static build exists. If STATIC_DIR missing → falls back to JSON. apiRouteSegments map includes 'watchlist' to protect /watchlist/extra paths from SPA fallback (returns 404 JSON, never index.html).
findings.recommendation: No action needed - content negotiation and path protection are correct.

findings.finding: PUT /watchlist/{ticker} (handleAddWatchlist) and DELETE /watchlist/{ticker} (handleRemoveWatchlist) validate ticker via normalizeTicker, look up security by ticker, return 404 if not found in catalog. Idempotent: add uses ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, remove is no-op if not present. No auth (single-user design per SPEC §2.3).
findings.recommendation: No action needed - mutator endpoints are correctly implemented per SPEC design.

findings.finding: putJSON/deleteJSON send Accept: application/json header, so they always receive JSON responses (not HTML negotiation). Loopback consideration: these mutate only the local user's watchlist (not DB pipelines like /refresh), so loopback-only restriction is not required for this single-user app.
ListWatchlist uses plain JOIN with securities and parameterized ORDER BY created_at, id - no user input in query construction.
IF NOT EXISTS guard makes CREATE TABLE idempotent. ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING on UNIQUE constraint makes watchlist operations idempotent.

summary.sql_injection_liking_escaping: PASS - escapeLike() correctly escapes % _ \ wildcards; all queries use parameterized placeholders ($1..$5); no string concatenation of user input into SQL.
summary.ranking_injection: PASS - ORDER BY CASE uses fixed columns and parameterized likes; no user-controlled text in ordering clause.
summary.fk_constraints_watchlist: PASS - FK ON DELETE CASCADE to securities(id), UNIQUE(security_id) constraint. Single-user design (no user_id) per SPEC §2.3.
summary.content_negotiation: PASS - serveSPAIndexNegotiated serves index.html only when Accept: text/html AND build exists; /watchlist/extra gives 404 JSON (apiRouteSegments protection). No path traversal - resolveWithin confines files to staticDir.
summary.mutator_endpoints: PASS - PUT/DELETE /watchlist/{ticker} validate ticker, return 404 if security missing, idempotent per SPEC. Single-user design, no auth required per SPEC §2.3.
summary.secrets_scan: PASS - No new secrets found in source code. DATABASE_URL present only in .env which is gitignored.
summary.dependencies: PASS - Only stdlib + pgx v5.11.0; no new dependencies added for M5.
